results.rationale: Consistency: white background remains, but the right turtle shifts and its head/limb pose changes, while shell and skin details are redrawn. Instruction: left turtle remains substantially taller and wider than the right, so the required size match is not accomplished. Quality: both turtles have coherent shell structure, textured limbs, faces and natural contact shadows without noticeable defects.

Consistency: three drawers, knobs and cabinet design remain, but the cabinet proportions are noticeably narrower. Instruction: left placement, warm wall, wood floor, linen curtain and angled sunlight are present; the bottom-right text contains storing sitems and ordering order, with malformed final-line characters, and is heavy rather than thin. Quality: cabinet and room appear coherent, but multiple duplicated/garbled words and damaged letterforms visibly degrade the poster.
